title: Rhapsody
identity: Warren Gooch's Rhapsody is a single-movement work in five sections for alto saxophone and piano. College Music Society's 2006 Great Plains Chapter concert program gives a composer program note: Marcato opening, extended cadenza/dialogue, Cantabile, perpetual motion, and scherzo with a partial return. It states the work was written for Randall Smith and Patrice Ewoldt and premiered at the 2003 World Saxophone Congress.

evidence.claim: College Music Society Great Plains Chapter program gives the 2006 performance by Randall Smith and Marilyn Musick and reproduces a composer note with five-section outline, cadenza, dedication, and 2003 World Saxophone Congress premiere.
evidence.source_name: College Music Society Great Plains Chapter conference program

evidence.claim: 2013 New Horizons Music Festival program lists Rhapsody by Gooch performed by Lindsey Davis and Janet Coggins.

review_focus: Inference: the extended cadenza and succession of contrasting sections focus review on pacing, formal continuity, and saxophone-piano dialogue.
collection_flag: Commissioned for named performers and programmed at a saxophone festival; no score observed.
gaps: No notation inspected and no recording playback auditioned.
